storage_modes.0: native BF16 inputs lifted losslessly to FP32 storage; all other factors FP32
storage_modes.1: native BF16 inputs stored as uint16; all originally FP32 factors remain FP32

scope: Finite capacity/horizon, explicit FP32 scalar K order. Reversed inner-MB K order is a deliberate negative control. Native input data is identical under the two storage choices; no FP32 factor quantization.
raw_output_policy: All raw outputs retained; identical byte sequences are hard-linked after SHA256+byte equality to avoid redundant archive payload.
